narrative.overview:
TI Ninja is a painted fascia and a sheet of glass after dark. The floor is near-black, the board is purple, and a flat lime tube is the only light that draws itself. Type does the work of a shop sign: large, tight, and mostly the paper color, with lime reserved for whatever is switched on — the price, the primary plate, the active word.

The sign stays open: a title in a dark bay, one sentence, two plates. The account is tighter: a readable form, one deep-purple result panel, a split bar, a ledger. Photographs sit in square windows under the same tube. Layers are opaque. The system refuses an eyebrow over the sign, a hero full of badges, a floating pill for navigation, and a row of equal cards.

Motion is two beats, then quiet. The fascia tube draws once from the left. The price figure settles when its text changes. On a phone, a rail repeats that same price only after the big figure has left upward.
keyCharacteristics: Night floor, painted purple board, flat lime tube
Sign face for the letreiro, readable face for the form
Opaque layers and a 2px plate radius
Lime price on deep-purple glass; the phone rail waits until that figure has left
One tube draw, one price settle; everything else stays still

rules.name: The Lit Mark Rule
rules.body: Lime is a flat fill, with no gradient and no glow. It marks the tube, the price, the primary plate, hovered and current links, form prefixes, the caret, text selection, the scrollbar thumb, and the margin slice of the split bar. One clause inside a sign may switch to lime. It does not fill a section.

rules.name: The Two Purples Rule
rules.body: Painted purple is the fascia and the closing band. Deep purple is the glass: the result panel, the photo window, the phone rail, and the pressed glass plate. They do not trade places.

rules.name: The Sign and the Form Rule
rules.body: Darker Grotesque carries the sign: headings, the price, nav, plates, and field names. Atkinson Hyperlegible carries paragraphs, help, and input values. The two do not swap.

rules.name: The Empty Bay Rule
rules.body: The title sits in the dark bay. Nothing is labeled above it.

rules.name: The Column Rule
rules.body: Body copy stops at 68ch. The hero lede stops at 36ch. The content column stops at 1120px inside the gutters.

rules.name: The Rail After the Figure Rule
rules.body: Below 900px, the fixed rail repeats the price only once that figure's bottom edge has crossed the top of the viewport. Until then the rail stays hidden.

rules.name: The Flat Layer Rule
rules.body: Depth is opaque stacks — floor, painted board, deep glass, photograph — not blur. Soft shadows sit only under the fascia, the result panel, and the phone rail.

rules.name: The Tube Once Rule
rules.body: The fascia tube scales from the left once, over 900ms. The tube on a result panel or photo window is already lit. Reduced motion shows every tube at full length and does not settle the price.

rules.name: The Near-Square Rule
rules.body: Plates, fields, and the notice field use a 2px radius. The nav, the result panel, photo windows, and the price rail are square. Nothing is a pill.

dos: Do paint the floor night (#100e12) and the fascia painted purple (#44335c), with a 4px tube of lime (#92c417) on the fascia, the result panel, each photo window, and the phone rail.
Do set signs, plates, nav, and field names in Darker Grotesque, and set paragraphs, help, and input values in Atkinson Hyperlegible.
Do keep plates and fields at a 2px radius and a minimum height of 3.1–3.25rem, with the 3px sign-paper focus ring offset by 3px.
Do keep the phone rail off until the big price's bottom edge has left the viewport upward, and only below 900px.
Do draw the fascia tube once over 900ms with cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), and settle the price over 420ms on the same curve only when its text changes. Skip both when reduced motion is requested.
donts: Don't place an eyebrow, kicker, or row of badges above a sign.
Don't build a section as a row of equal cards. Use one glass panel, a photo window beside text, or a list.
Don't frost a surface with backdrop blur, and don't use a hard offset shadow. The only blur is the price figure's settle.
Don't wash a region in lime, and don't set the price in any color but lime.
Don't use pill shapes for the nav, plates, fields, or the rail.
